info.title: Capstone attack path analyser
info.description: Upload a CloudFormation template; get its findings, ranked attack paths, graphs and fix impact.

get.description: Styles, enums, samples and limits the web app needs before anything else.

Core readiness, plus the optional PDF and model capabilities.

The PDF probe runs once per app and is cached. Neither optional capability
can make `ok` false.

post.description:
Compute fix impact for this scope, or return the saved result.

Each candidate finding is suppressed in turn and the selected paths are
found again. That models removing the evidence, not a verified repair.

get.description:
The path's scenario state: idle, queued, warming_up, running, done, cached
or failed. Poll it while the status is queued, warming_up or running.

post.description:
Serve the cached scenario (200) or start or join a live generation (202).

After a failure, POST again to start a new job; nothing is retried
automatically. 503 when live generation is unavailable and nothing is
cached. Retry-After is sent only when waiting can help (queue full, quota
exhausted, with the time to the reset when known); not when live generation
is not configured or the Space is paused or broken. 429, with Retry-After,
when this client has started too many live generations recently.

202.description: A job is queued or running

get.description:
The saved analysis as a PDF security assessment.

Includes fix impact only when a result for the same scope was already
computed (POST /fixes); otherwise the report says "Impact estimates not
included". Scenarios appear only for paths that already have one cached.
One report renders at a time; another request meanwhile is 503 with
Retry-After. A repeat of a finished report is served without rendering
and does not count toward the per-client report limit (429).

parameters.name: top

schema.description: How many of the top selected paths to detail, or "all". A value that reaches the selected count means all of them; at most 50 paths are detailed, and the report says when it shows fewer than were asked for. With no selected paths the report covers findings only.

What suppressing one finding does to the selected path set.

Suppression models evidence removal, not a verified repair.

PathRisk.title: PathRisk
PathRisk.description:
The contextual risk model's second opinion on a path (risk_scoring/).

It does not change the path's score, level, rank or export. Its weights are
provisional and uncalibrated.
